source: Daniel (4Q114), Qumran -- unreviewed machine-draft translation, Open Dead Sea (opendeadsea.org, CC BY-NC 4.0)

1.1: And behold, a man, one clothed in linens and girded at the hips
1.2: In gold, Uphaz, and a body like Tarshish, and faces like the sight of lightning
1.3: And [the] eye like torches of fire, and [its] arm, and [its] feet like [the] appearance of bronze.
1.4: Burnished and the sound his word as the sound of the commotion and I saw I Daniel to his linen
1.5: The vision and the men who were with me did not see the vision
1.6: Verily, trembling great, it fell upon them, and they ran away in hiding.
1.7: And I remained to see the great sight this
1.8: And not remained in strength and splendour turned upon to destruction and not
1.9: I restrained strength and I heard the sound of his words
1.10: The sound of his words and I was dazed upon the face and the face of the earth
1.12: Daniel, man of preciousness(es), understand in the words which I [am] speaking to you
1.13: And stand upon your place, that now I have sent to you, and in speaking with you
1.14: The word this I stood trembling and he said to do not fear Daniel that
1.15: From the first day, which you gave your heart to understand and to humble yourself before your God
1.16: They heard the word, and I have come in the way of the chiefs of the kingdom of Persia

2.1: to my counterpart twenty and one day and behold Michael one of the princes
2.2: The first ones came to help me and I remained there by the kings of Persia and I came
2.3: to make you understand what will meet your people in the end of days, for there is still a vision for days
2.4: And as speaking with as these words I gave the face of the land and I was bound and behold
2.5: As likeness of sons of man touched upon my lips and I opened my mouth and I spoke and I said
2.6: To the one standing before my lord in a vision, the messengers turned upon me, and I did not restrain
2.12: Verily, I will report to you the written trustworthiness
2.13: And there is no one [who] shows himself strong with these [Michael] your chief And I
2.14: In the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood to strengthen and fortify him, and now
2.15: Trustworthiness, I report to you: behold, still three kings standing for Persia and the fourth
2.16: He will gain great wealth more than everyone and in his riches he will blind the whole kingdom

3.12: Great and in property much and in those times many will stand upon the king of the south and the descendants of Perez
3.13: They will be lifted to stand in the vision and stumble. And he will come, the king of the north, and pour out and seize a town.
3.14: Fortifications and arms of the south will not stand and a people of his choice and no strength to stand and he made the coming
3.15: As his pleasure, there is none standing before his face. And he will stand in the land of the beauty and all its protection. And he will put his sons to come in power.
3.16: and the upright with him and he will make and with a daughter of men he will give to destroy and she will not stand

4.13: For they had planned on his thoughts and ate a piece, they break his strength
4.14: He washes off and they fell many slain ones. And the two kings their heart.
4.15: To an evil deed and upon one table of lies they will speak, and it will not prosper, that still the end
4.16: To [the] appointment and he will return his land with great property and his heart upon [the] covenant of holiness and he made and he returned to his land to [the] appointment he will return and he came
4.17: In the south and it was not like the first and like the last
